# Vendored headers

Single-header libraries copied verbatim; do not edit them. Update by replacing the file and the version here.

| File | Library | Version | License | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ArduinoJson.h` | [ArduinoJson](https://arduinojson.org) | 7.2.1 | MIT | Device core (JSON protocol). Plain C++, no Arduino core needed. |
| `doctest.h` | [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | 2.4.11 | MIT | native Device core tests |
